cards.mood: The track opens with a grounded, introspective atmosphere that quickly establishes a confident and assertive tone.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a smooth, resonant baritone timbre that carries a slight rasp, adding texture and grit to the melodic lines.
cards.palette: A melancholic, bell-like synthesizer melody serves as the central harmonic motif, present from the intro through to the outro, providing a consistent emotional anchor.
